name: Conservation Theories and Approaches of Built Heritage
description: This course will acquaint participants with the discipline of architectural conservation, its origins, developments and inherent contradictions. The course will cover the range of scales of conservation,from the smallest denominator of artifact conservation to large-scale urban conservation. Students will be better positioned to appreciate and approach the question of conservation/preservation versus development/demolition and better prepared to understand the process, techniques, standards, and other considerations that define a high quality conservation effort upon the completion of the course.
